title: HomeFlood Payment Plan Offerings and Installment Fee
content:
**HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies** premiums are paid under one of the payment plans the tier offers.

| Tier | Plans offered | Fee on each installment after the first (USD) | Only plan when the lender pays from escrow |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeFlood Renters | ANNUAL, semi-annual, QUARTERLY | 6 | ANNUAL |
| HomeFlood Essential | ANNUAL, semi-annual, QUARTERLY | 6 | ANNUAL |
| HomeFlood Standard | ANNUAL, semi-annual, QUARTERLY | 6 | ANNUAL |
| HomeFlood Plus | ANNUAL, semi-annual, QUARTERLY | 6 | ANNUAL |
| HomeFlood Premier | ANNUAL, semi-annual, QUARTERLY | 6 | ANNUAL |
| HomeFlood Estate | ANNUAL, semi-annual, QUARTERLY | 6 | ANNUAL |

## Billing desk notes

- Every tier offers all three plans.
- The installment fee is charged on each installment after the first on the semi-annual and QUARTERLY plans. The ANNUAL plan has no installment after the first, so it carries no installment fee.
- When the premium is paid by the lender out of escrow, ANNUAL is the only plan available.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a QUARTERLY plan has three installments after the first, so it carries three installment fees of 6 USD each over the term.
